lead: I design the brand, build the website or the software behind it, and make the content that brings people in.
body: Most businesses have a good product and a messy online presence. The logo says one thing, the website says another, the ads look like a third company, and the team still runs on spreadsheets. I fix all of it, using AI to move fast, so it looks and works like one serious business.
close: If your business is better than it looks online, I'd love to hear about it.
